name: The Transfer of Relics and Garb of the Holy Apostles Andrew, Thomas and John the Theologian, the Disciple Luke, the Prophet Elisei (Elisha) and the Martyr Lazarus:
life: The Transfer of Relics and Garb of the Holy Apostles Andrew, Thomas and John the Theologian, the Disciple Luke, the Prophet Elisei (Elisha) and the Martyr Lazarus: Found during the time of the emperor Romanos Lakapenos (919-944) in a monastery of Saint Augusta, the clothing was solemnly transferred by holy Patriarch Polyeuktos (956-970) into the church of the Apostles.
